goal: Diagnose and correct misleading UpCloud account preview failure while preserving strict proxy egress and all deployed configuration.
context: User submitted screenshot: UpCloud account validation via DataImpulse SOCKS5 says Could not reach provider. Live same selected gateway/sticky preview session answered api.ipify.org 200 in 1.2s and UpCloud unauthenticated endpoints 401 in 0.12-1.0s. No saved UpCloud account/token; previous submitted token is not retained; do not read secrets into logs or ask to paste token. Current source maps malformed JSON/list schema errors and catalog unavailable into the same misleading transport message and logs no stage. Implement safe stage/class/operation/status/reason/request-id/elapsed diagnostics in UI and journal, never raw bodies, URLs, credentials or arbitrary provider error strings. Separate valid HTTP response schema failures from transport without altering retry/create ambiguity safety. Catalog empty diagnostics count only. Preserve original route/gateway, no direct fallback, no network mutations/canary. User must retry validation after rollout to identify authenticated failing stage; be honest that original root is not recoverable from historical logs. Do not speculate schema acceptance changes. Retain UpCloud storage ownership/gates and permanent residential publication. Existing project user requires orchestrator/OpenAI API planning, tests, reversible deploy and handoff.
commit_message: fix(upcloud): expose safe staged preview failure diagnostics
